question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **breach**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Breach **means the violation or infraction of a law, obligation, agreement, or standard. (किसी कानून, दायित्व, समझौते या मानक का उल्लंघन)

 
 
• **Example**: *The employee's unauthorized access to sensitive company information constituted a breach of the company's security policies.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**breach**" is a comprehensive term that captures various violations or infractions related to data privacy, ethical conduct in business, and the legitimacy of operations.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agreement: **Mutual understanding or harmony between parties. (पार्टियों के बीच आपसी समझ या सामंजस्य)
 
• **Closure: **Bringing something to an end or resolution. (किसी बात को अंत या समाधान तक पहुंचाना)
 
• **Spread: **The extent or distribution of something over an area or range. (किसी क्षेत्र या सीमा पर किसी चीज़ का विस्तार या वितरण)
